validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="go" target="b">
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

primary.message: `</state>` closes an outer element while `<transition>` is still open

notes: SCXML documents must be well-formed XML 1.0 with namespaces; no later validation runs until parsing succeeds
diagnostics.help: `<transition>` has no content, so end its start tag with `/>`
